title: ZAN
synopsis: During Japan’s Warring States period, the warrior ZAN was locked in a fierce battle at Azuchi Castle. Guided by the mysterious voice of a young girl, he steps beyond time and space into another world—a realm where he must face powerful rivals and monstrous beings known as Tropes. RIKKA, the ruler who commands the Tropes—the very symbols of life—maintains the world’s order. Questioning the justice behind his own battles, ZAN embarks on a journey to uncover the truth, joined by Panther, a mechanical lifeform, and Uzume, the enigmatic girl who called out to him. title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
synopsis: In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out. After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks… (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: "If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married." Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom! (Source: K MANGA)

title: DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS (Working Title)
synonyms: デス・ストランディング
synopsis: An original anime series based on the “Death Stranding” video game. Once, there was an explosion... Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink a legendary porter set out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the someones are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting

Her very existence will shake the foundation of this world. (Source: RE:BEL ROBOTICA Official Site, translated)

title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
synopsis: Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra. Dragged into becoming a Dark Machine player by Rudra, Kairi’s talent gradually blossoms over the course of many intense battles. title: Watari Tori to Katatsumuri
synopsis: Unpei Mochizuki had been working for two years as a spare parts dealer. After making a mistake, he had only one wish: to go far, where no one can recognize him. That’s when he crosses paths with Tsugumi Nagisa, illustrator… and nomad. A woman of indefinable age, who lives with her dog in a van. Unpei begins a new life on the road with Tsugumi and her car. Far from the usual tidy, sedentary lifestyle, the nomadic spirit offers new surprises every single day. From beaches to mountains, from the North to the South… Freedom and endless new landscapes await! (Source: Noeve grafx, translated)
